# Al Harmain Travels

> Al Harmain Travels is a premier, licensed VIP chauffeur and passenger transportation provider in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia (MOT License #4029). The company specializes in private Umrah and Hajj pilgrim transfers, airport pickups, intercity travel, and private Ziyarat heritage tours connecting Makkah Al-Mukarramah, Al-Madinah Al-Munawwarah, Jeddah, and Taif.

## Overview & Business Information

- **Company Name**: Al Harmain Travels
- **Tagline**: VIP Umrah & City Taxi Services
- **Official Licensing**: Licensed Operator #4029 under the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia Ministry of Transport (MOT)
- **Central Operations Hub**: Ibrahim Al Khalil Street, Central Area, Makkah Al-Mukarramah, Saudi Arabia
- **Service Availability**: 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, 365 days a year
- **Primary Service Regions**: Makkah Al-Mukarramah, Al-Madinah Al-Munawwarah, Jeddah (King Abdulaziz International Airport & Seaport), and Taif
- **Currency**: Saudi Riyal (SAR)
- **Official Website**: [Al Harmain Travels](https://alharmaintravels.com)

## Core Transportation Services

Al Harmain Travels operates fully licensed, private, door-to-door transportation services tailored to individual pilgrims, families, and executive VIP delegations:

- **Airport Transfers (King Abdulaziz International Airport - JED & Prince Mohammad Bin Abdulaziz Airport - MED)**:
  - Direct meet-and-greet service inside passenger terminals upon arrival.
  - Coverage across all King Abdulaziz International Airport (KAIA) terminals: Terminal 1, Terminal H (Hajj & Umrah Terminal), and North Terminal (Terminal N).
  - Real-time automated flight tracking to accommodate flight delays without penalty.
  - Luggage handling, escorting to the vehicle, and direct drop-off at hotel suites.
- **Jeddah – Makkah Transfers**:
  - Express intercity highway transfer connecting Jeddah (KAIA airport terminals or coastal hotels) and Makkah Al-Mukarramah (~80–95 km, ~60–75 minutes).
  - Authorized clearance for direct drop-off at hotels located in the immediate Haram sanctuary zone and Ibrahim Al Khalil corridor.
- **Makkah – Madinah Transfers**:
  - Comfortable long-distance highway transfer via the Hijrah expressway (~435 km, ~4 to 4.5 hours).
  - Available as one-way journeys or same-day round-trip transfers with scheduled rest stops.
- **Private Intercity Transfers**:
  - Private non-stop transfers between any residential address, hotel, or transit station in Makkah, Madinah, Jeddah, and Taif.
- **Makkah Ziyarat Tours**:
  - Comprehensive, private spiritual heritage tours visiting venerated historical landmarks across Makkah Al-Mukarramah.
  - Key sites include Jabal Al-Noor (Cave of Hira / Ghar Hira), Jabal Thawr (Cave of Thawr), Mina, Muzdalifah, the Plains of Arafat (Jabal Al-Rahmah), and Masjid Aisha (Al-Taneem).
- **Taif Ziyarat Tours**:
  - Scenic mountain excursions from Makkah to Taif and the historic Bani Saad region.
  - Key sites include historic Taif masjids (Masjid Abdullah Ibn Abbas, Masjid Addas), Shubra Palace, Al-Hada mountain pass, authentic rose distilleries, and Halimah As-Sa'diyah Village.
- **Custom Transportation & Hourly Hire**:
  - Tailored itineraries for corporate groups, private delegations, and extended family itineraries requiring dedicated on-demand chauffeur availability.

## Vehicle Fleet

The fleet consists of late-model (2024–2026), meticulously inspected, air-conditioned passenger vehicles maintained under strict safety standards:

- **Toyota Camry (Hybrid Executive)**:
  - Vehicle Category: Executive Sedan
  - Passenger Capacity: Up to 3 passengers
  - Luggage Capacity: 2 large suitcases
  - Key Features: Quiet hybrid powertrain, dual-zone climate control, leather trim, complimentary chilled mineral water, and direct central hotel drop-off clearance.
  - Best Suited For: Solo travelers, couples, and executive business transfers.
- **Hyundai Sonata**:
  - Vehicle Category: Executive Sedan
  - Passenger Capacity: Up to 3 passengers
  - Luggage Capacity: 2 large suitcases
  - Key Features: Contemporary styling, generous rear legroom, high-efficiency air conditioning, and smooth highway ride.
  - Best Suited For: Budget-conscious pilgrims seeking private sedan comfort.
- **Hyundai Staria VIP**:
  - Vehicle Category: Premium VIP Van / Multi-Purpose Vehicle (MPV)
  - Passenger Capacity: Up to 7 passengers
  - Luggage Capacity: 5 large suitcases
  - Key Features: Futuristic aerodynamic cabin, individual reclining VIP captain seats, tri-zone automatic climate control, panoramic privacy glass, and USB-C charging ports for every seat.
  - Best Suited For: Families, elder pilgrims, and small traveling groups.
- **GMC Yukon XL (Denali VIP)**:
  - Vehicle Category: VIP Ultra Luxury SUV Flagship
  - Passenger Capacity: Up to 7 passengers
  - Luggage Capacity: 6 large suitcases (expansive trunk volume)
  - Key Features: Sovereign road presence, premium leather captain chairs, superior sound insulation, tinted privacy windows, priority Haram gate access, and senior protocol chauffeur.
  - Best Suited For: Dignitaries, VIP delegations, and travelers requiring uncompromising luxury.
- **HiRoof Minibus (Toyota HiAce Royal Lounge / Nusuk Specification)**:
  - Vehicle Category: Group & Family Minibus
  - Passenger Capacity: Up to 10–11 passengers
  - Luggage Capacity: 10 large suitcases (dedicated rear luggage storage)
  - Key Features: High-roof walk-in ceiling clearance, contoured high-back reclining group seats, powerful dual overhead air conditioning units, and ample luggage volume.
  - Best Suited For: Extended family groups, Umrah groups, and multi-city Ziyarat tours.

## Key Destinations & Coverage

- **Makkah Al-Mukarramah**: Masjid Al-Haram, Clock Royal Tower (Abraj Al-Bait), Jabal Omar hotels, Aziziyah, Al-Naseem, and central hotels along Ibrahim Al Khalil and Ajyad streets.
- **Al-Madinah Al-Munawwarah**: Al-Masjid An-Nabawi (Prophet's Mosque) northern and southern courtyard gates, Central Area Markaziyah hotels, Prince Mohammad Bin Abdulaziz International Airport (MED), and Quba Mosque.
- **Jeddah**: King Abdulaziz International Airport (KAIA - Terminals 1, H, and North), Jeddah Islamic Port, Jeddah Corniche, and major commercial and hospitality centers.
- **Taif**: Al-Hada, Ash-Shafa, central Taif historical district, and Halimah As-Sa'diyah heritage area in Bani Saad.

## Booking Process

1. **Route & Date Selection**: Visit the [Al Harmain Travels Booking Page](https://alharmaintravels.com/booking) to select pickup location (airport terminal, hotel, or city landmark), destination, travel date, and pickup time.
2. **Vehicle Class Choice**: Choose the optimal vehicle category based on party size and baggage requirements (Toyota Camry, Hyundai Sonata, Hyundai Staria VIP, GMC Yukon XL, or HiRoof Minibus).
3. **Flight & Passenger Details**: Provide your flight number for airport pickups (enabling automated flight arrival tracking) and passenger contact details.
4. **Instant Reservation & Dispatch**: Receive upfront, transparent fare confirmation in Saudi Riyals (SAR). The booking is transmitted directly to the 24/7 central dispatch desk.
5. **Chauffeur Assignment & Meet**: Driver credentials and contact details are communicated prior to arrival. Your chauffeur awaits at the arrival terminal or hotel entrance with luggage assistance and door-to-door transport.

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

### How does airport pickup work at King Abdulaziz International Airport (JED)?
For airport pickups, your chauffeur monitors your inbound flight number in real time. Following aircraft landing, immigration clearance, and baggage claim, your chauffeur greets you at the specified terminal exit (Terminal 1, Terminal H, or North Terminal) holding a name board or coordinating directly via WhatsApp.

### Are the quoted fares fixed or metered?
All fares are fixed and transparent upfront. Quoted prices include applicable road taxes, highway tolls, terminal pickup clearance, and standard flight delay waiting buffers. There are no hidden surge fees.

### Can your vehicles drop passengers directly at hotels near the Haram?
Yes. Al Harmain Travels operates under official Saudi Ministry of Transport licensing, granting our fleet authorized clearance to access hotel zones, ring roads, and courtyard perimeters surrounding the Holy Mosques in both Makkah and Madinah.

### Do I need to pay extra if my flight is delayed?
No. Because all airport bookings require flight number details, our dispatch software monitors live flight statuses. Chauffeur pickup times are automatically updated to match actual wheels-down timing without cancellation or penalty.

### Can I book private Ziyarat tours, and is the itinerary customizable?
Yes. All Ziyarat tours are entirely private for your party. Chauffeurs wait at each historical landmark (such as Mount Uhud, Quba Mosque, Cave of Hira, or Taif heritage locations) while you visit, offering a relaxed and unhurried spiritual experience.

### What languages do the chauffeurs speak?
Chauffeurs are multilingual, fluent in Arabic and English, with many possessing working proficiency in Urdu and other regional languages commonly spoken by pilgrims.

### How can I make an urgent or last-minute reservation?
Last-minute bookings can be processed either directly through the [Booking Page](https://alharmaintravels.com/booking) or via the 24/7 WhatsApp dispatch desk at [+966 54 888 1234](https://wa.me/966548881234).
